standard_prerequisites.name: Etale dominates smooth
standard_prerequisites.use: The claim that smooth covers refine etale-locally.

core_obligations: Observe conditions (2)(3) are topology-independent; reduce to showing X is an fppf stack.
Build the etale groupoid presentation [U/R]_etale -> X from the representing space R, prove it an equivalence using the etale-refines-smooth claim.
Compare [U/R]_etale with the fppf quotient stack [U/R]: both covered by U with fibre product R, so fully faithful; then show every fppf object comes etale-locally from U and conclude the equivalence.
proof_roadmap: Topology-independence reduction, etale groupoid presentation with the refinement claim, fully-faithfulness from the shared R, and essential surjectivity via etale-local lifting of fppf objects.
difficulty_reason: Four-stage argument (reduction, presentation, ff, es) each with real content and a claim needing its own citation.
